mathematicalHorizon.group: G(g)=max(b+w,own strike H,literal local-observation correct-claimant H)<=max(b+3w,a+5w)<=a+1250ms at delta<=20
mathematicalHorizon.noRecursion: Never wait for commit/group of a cohort member of a direct claimant. Its own fixed H uses cohort LOCAL windows only.
mathematicalHorizon.terminal: Explicit clamp, unclamped witness preserved; manual NOT_REACHED retained; no invented future acoustic coverage.

causalInventory.hypothesisSupport: Background EVALUATION verdicts contain reserved local observations released after group closure. Known target regressions have different causes: competing WRONG allocation or legal MATCHED ownership, not the proposed premature-release mechanism. No claim that this hypothesis repairs all R2 target errors.

protections.R4Scope: Finite measured sessions, not proof of indefinite stability.

limitations: Already exposed frozen XC2 data only; not fresh/blind/generalization evidence or a scientific winner.
Known competing-WRONG and correct-owner counterfactual conflicts are not assumed to be reservation-release bugs.
Logical finalization uses historical publication availability; no new device/runtime/UI/perceptual latency evidence.
Bounded analysis frontiers do not bound wall-clock latency if acoustic publication stalls.
No natural independent fixed-BPM human capture qualification, latency SLO or commercial qualification.
github: Actual post-push GitHub receipt appended separately; empty statuses and workflow runs mean NOT CI PASS.
